changes: Computers you've removed from your account no longer clutter Settings › Devices. Show them again with the button below the list.
A computer that was removed from your account now says so, and can start over to be added again with a new code. Its old data is kept in a backup folder.
Leaving your last hub now takes you to a screen where you can join one again, instead of an empty window.
Keep a folder in step between two of your own computers: subscribe to it from each one. Files added, changed or deleted on either side show up on the other.
Adding a computer to your account now says clearly that you need to approve it on your other computer, and that computer shows a banner asking you to review it.
When a hub's admin hasn't let you in yet, or a hub refuses this computer, a banner says so instead of just "Not connected".
The app icon no longer looks scrambled at small sizes on Mac.
First release: share folders from your computer with people you know, and download straight from theirs.
Search everything shared with you, with previews of pictures, videos, music, PDFs and text.
Choose who can see each folder or file: only you, particular people or groups, or everyone on a hub.
Follow a friend's folder to get new files automatically.
Let AI assistants such as Claude use Communal for you (Settings › AI agents).
